WeatherResponse.title: WeatherResponse
WeatherResponse.description: One location and the series the request asked for. Every `*_units` map documents its data map.

latitude.description: Latitude of the grid cell that served the request; may differ slightly from the one asked for.

longitude.description: Longitude of the grid cell that served the request.

generationtime_ms.description: Server time spent generating the response, in milliseconds.

utc_offset_seconds.description: Offset of `timezone` from UTC, in seconds.

timezone.description: Time zone the times are expressed in, as requested or resolved from `auto`.

elevation.description: Elevation of the grid cell in metres, used for downscaling.

current_units.description: Unit of every requested variable, plus the `time` format, keyed like the data map.

additionalProperties.description: Unit label as the API prints it.

current.description: The latest value of every requested variable, plus `time` and the `interval` in seconds it covers.

additionalProperties.description: One value: a number, `time` as ISO 8601 text, or `null` where the model has none.

hourly_units.description: Unit of every requested variable, plus the `time` format, keyed like the data map.

additionalProperties.description: Unit label as the API prints it.

hourly.description: One column per requested variable, plus `time`, all the same length.

additionalProperties.description: A column: numbers (`null` where a value is missing), or strings for `time` and any ISO 8601 variable.

items.description: One value; `null` where the model has none.

anyOf.description: String column: `time` as ISO 8601, or a variable the API renders as text.

daily_units.description: Unit of every requested variable, plus the `time` format, keyed like the data map.

additionalProperties.description: Unit label as the API prints it.

daily.description: One column per requested variable, plus `time`, all the same length.

additionalProperties.description: A column: numbers (`null` where a value is missing), or strings for `time` and any ISO 8601 variable.

items.description: One value; `null` where the model has none.

anyOf.description: String column: `time` as ISO 8601, or a variable the API renders as text.
